description: Authentic nInvaders classic arcade architecture. The binary decouples alien swarm formation tables (0x00405100), four-bunker defensive erosion bitmasks (0x00405240), missile trajectory tables (0x00405400), and hardware player/game registers from the per-tick game loop. GhostGraph uses FalkorDB to resolve multi-hop memory provenance and synthesize verified modern Python.

global_memory.label: ALIEN_BLOCK_GRID
global_memory.description: 5x10 matrix of alien ships (Row 0: type 1 squid 30pts, Rows 1-2: type 2 crab 20pts, Rows 3-4: type 3 octopus 10pts). Initialized by aliensReset.

global_memory.label: BUNKER_EROSION_GRID
global_memory.description: Four defensive bunkers erosion bitmask array (4 rows x 81 columns). 1 indicates solid shield wall, 0 indicates eroded cavity. Initialized by bunkersReset.

global_memory.label: LOWEST_SHIP_TABLE
global_memory.description: Lowest active alien row index per column (0-9) used for missile launch targeting. Calculated by render.

global_memory.label: ALIEN_MISSILE_STATE
global_memory.description: Active alien missile coordinates [x0, y0, x1, y1, ...]. Initialized by aliensReset, advanced by aliensMissileMove.

global_memory.label: ALIENS_SWARM_STATE
global_memory.description: Alien fleet dynamic bounding box and velocity state (posX, posY, right, bottom, left, speed, shipnum).

global_memory.label: PLAYER_SHIP_STATE
global_memory.description: Player defense cannon state (posX, posY, lives, is_exploding).

global_memory.label: GAME_SESSION_STATE
global_memory.description: Global arcade session status (score, highscore, level, is_game_over).
